name: The Loft
notes: Dive gay bar in Hillcrest (3610 5th Ave). No official website found. Pool table, jukebox, karaoke, drink specials (Happy Hour, Tequila Tuesday) -- no food menu or per-item priced food found in any source (Yelp, TripAdvisor, GayCities, Hillcrest Bars, menu directories). Matches the drink-only dive bar not-found criteria.

name: Grant Grill
notes: Fine dining restaurant (US Grant Hotel, downtown San Diego). Own site publishes the full menu text -- Breakfast, Brunch, Lunch, Dinner, Kids, Lounge Food, Lounge Beverages, Seasonal Cocktails, full wine/spirits list -- with every dish name and description, but literally zero prices anywhere in the page HTML (verified: dish blocks like 'Prime Rib Baguette Sandwich' contain only a name+description div, no price element at all). Only price-like text on the whole page is a '$5 delivery charge' note. Web search for third-party priced menus (Tripadvisor, OpenTable, restaurantguru) turned up no reliable per-item prices either. This matches the playbook's 'fine-dining room that prices only the caviar' not-found pattern -- here it doesn't even price the caviar.

name: Pizza & Pasta Buffet
notes: All-you-can-eat buffet restaurant inside Legoland California. Page describes it as an 'All You Can Eat' / 'Buffet' venue with per-person pricing tied to park admission tiers ($69/$189/$239 are Legoland ticket/annual-pass prices, not menu prices). No itemized per-dish menu exists anywhere on the page or site -- it is a single all-in buffet price, matching the not-found criteria for a buffet with one all-in price.

name: Lucys
notes: Address (4906 Voltaire St, Ocean Beach) resolves to Lucy's Tavern, a dive bar/music venue established 1993 -- not a taco shop despite the work-list name similarity to Lucy's Taco Shop (a different, unrelated business at 109 W C St, restaurantId 4095). No official website. Its Toast 'local' page is a directory/discovery page listing nearby restaurants' online-ordering links (BBQ House, Dirty Birds, OB Surf Lodge, Raglan Public House, The Harp, Wings Army) -- Lucy's Tavern itself has no online-ordering link and no menu content of its own on that page, meaning no food ordering/menu via Toast. No priced food menu found anywhere. Drink-only dive bar, not-found.

name: Body Shop
notes: The listed website (bodyshopexpress.com) is an unrelated auto body repair shop at a nearby address (3777 Gaines St) -- not a restaurant/bar. Web search identifies 'Body Shop' as a San Diego adult entertainment venue at 3776 Riley St, marked CLOSED on Yelp. Permanently closed business with no menu; wrong website in the work list points to a different business entirely (auto repair) with no food service.

name: Flora
notes: Own-site PDF menus (linked from floranorthpark.com/menus and /brunch-menu). Both pdftotext -layout and -raw scrambled the two-column brunch menu badly enough that names could not be confidently paired with prices from text extraction alone (a known PDF failure mode per the playbook) -- resolved by visually reading the rendered PDF pages instead, which cleanly shows every dish, price and the full drinks/wine/cocktail menu with no ambiguity. Two brunch items ('Fettucine Pink Vodka Sauce' protein add-ons, 'Green Chilaquiles' protein add-ons) have optional protein add-on modifiers (e.g. 'grilled chicken 6') that were left off as they are modifiers, not standalone dishes. Site is tagged 'Brunch & Dinner Restaurant' in search results and its own hours only list Brunch service, and only Brunch + Drinks PDFs are linked from the site -- no separate dinner menu was found or is linked.
